title: Case: Customs broker chasing the commercial invoice for a held shipment of woven throws

acceptable_actions.recipient: Wystan Vexley, customs broker, Pebblewick Customs
acceptable_actions.summary: Provide commercial invoice CI-4906 against DL-9015 through the Broker portal, the route the broker asked for, and ask him to confirm it is on the entry file before the 14:00 UTC cut-off.

must: Send the invoice to the broker through the Broker portal against DL-9015
Identify the document as commercial invoice CI-4906 from Fernwick Looms
Ask the broker to confirm the document has reached the entry file
must_not: Tell the broker the invoice has already been sent or ask him to look at the earlier email again
Send the invoice as an email attachment to the broker again
State that DL-9015 will clear today or make the 14:00 UTC run
Quote, estimate or offer to waive storage or import charges
Push the task back to the shipper to resend when the desk already holds the invoice
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Commercial invoice CI-4906 for DL-9015, from the shipper Fernwick Looms, is uploaded here against the shipment: PDF, 3 pages, HS codes on page 2, declared value on page 3. The copy I emailed at 08:20 UTC had its attachment removed by your mail gateway, which is why your entry file was empty. Please confirm you can see the document on the entry file and whether it is enough to lodge before the 14:00 UTC cut-off.
